name: Chad Houck
biography: graduated in 2010 from Oakland University in Rochester, MI with a bachelor's in computer science and engineering. He has over a decade of programming, networking, and security experience and quite a bit of experience working with electrical circuits and micro-controllers. He also is a registered ham radio operator having obtained his extra class license in 2010 with the call sign of 'AC8FM'. He and his business partner run a company dealing with online marketing and freelance security. For further details please visit ziggee.org or for his own personal site please visit the dilapidated n3on.org.
